event_records.description: The meal train sign-up has eight slots claimed and six slots remaining. Fran and the neighbors are aware of the sign-up.

fran.name: Fran
fran.persona_brief:
You are Fran.
Fran posted the meal train sign-up to the neighborhood app on the evening of 2026-10-04. Eight slots were claimed that evening. Fran wants to fill all fourteen slots within four days to support the Okafor family.

neighbors_on_alder_court.name: Neighbors on Alder Court
neighbors_on_alder_court.persona_brief:
You are Neighbors on Alder Court.
The neighbors are a group of sixty households on Alder Court who use the neighborhood app. Some may have already signed up for a slot; others may not have seen the post yet or may be considering it. They have varying degrees of familiarity with the Okafor family and willingness to help.

resolution.question: Will the neighbors on Alder Court fill all fourteen slots of the meal train they started for the Okafor family within four days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that all fourteen slots of the meal train were claimed by 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
